findings.description: The fictional title 黒首島奇譚 uses an island name composed of black and neck. WH substitutes Beatnik Island, losing that name imagery and introducing an unrelated cultural word. The replacement recurs in the subsequent title mention.

contexts.japanese: 「……“斯様にして、我が黒首島奇譚は幕を閉じるのである。”
contexts.japanesePC: 「......“斯様にして、我が黒首島奇譚は幕を閉じるのである。”.........＜了＞。」
contexts.japanesePS3: 「……“斯様にして、我が黒首島奇譚は幕を閉じるのである。”
contexts.WH: "......And so, the curtain closes on the strange tale of Beatnik Island.  ......The End."
contexts.MG: "...And so, the curtain closes on the strange tale of Kurokubi Island.
contexts.UP: "......And so, the curtain closes on the strange tale of Kurokubi Island.
contexts.note: Both Kurokubi Island restores actual proper title, not Beatnik. Transliteration acceptable; black-neck literal gloss unnecessary.

findings.sourceReading: Strange Tale of Black-Neck Island, or a consistent transliteration of the Japanese island name if its reading is independently established.
findings.alternative: Fictional names may be adapted, but no wordplay or contextual link justifying Beatnik was found in this passage or the other occurrence. Fanfiction using WH’s title does not establish source-side authorization. The dramatic function of completing their first joint novel survives, limiting severity.

findings.description: MG turns Ikuko’s cheerful manner into an intention to cheer the narrator up

contexts.japanese: でも、……彼女が私に対し、上機嫌に接していることだけは理解できた。
contexts.japanesePS3: でも、……彼女が私に対し、上機嫌に接していることだけは理解できた。
contexts.MG: However, ...I was able to pick up on the fact...that she was trying to cheer me up.
contexts.UP: However, ......I was able to pick up on the fact...that she was trying to talk to me cheerfully.

findings.sourceReading: The narrator notices her cheerful manner toward him. OriginalPC215811/215812 and UP retain this; MG supplies a purpose of changing his mood.
findings.alternative: Her playful introduction may have that effect, but observed cheerfulness does not establish intent to cheer him up.
